Third-party parts in MechWarrior 1 Remake
======================================

MechWarrior 1 Remake (the mw1 program and its mw1data folder) is built on the
MechWarrior 3 rebuild. The engine's libraries and fonts are listed in that
package's own THIRD-PARTY.txt. The parts below are MW1's own additions.
Thank you to all of their authors.


Saira Condensed Bold and ExtraBold (mw1data/fonts)
--------------------------------------------------
The screens' plaques, titles, tiles and buttons. Copyright 2016 The Saira
Project Authors, https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/Saira. SIL Open Font License
1.1 (mw1data/fonts/SairaCondensed-OFL.txt). Unchanged, under the reserved name
"Saira".


Share Tech and Share Tech Mono (mw1data/fonts)
----------------------------------------------
The Mech Lab's data and lists, the terminal panels and the status line.
Share Tech: Copyright 2012 The Share Tech Project Authors. Share Tech Mono:
Copyright (c) 2012, Carrois Type Design, Ralph du Carrois. Both are at
https://github.com/google/fonts. SIL Open Font License 1.1
(mw1data/fonts/ShareTech-OFL.txt and ShareTechMono-OFL.txt). Unchanged, under
the reserved name "Share".


stb_image (built into mw1)
--------------------------
stb_image.h v2.30 by Sean Barrett, https://github.com/nothings/stb. Public
domain or MIT licence, at the user's choice; the licence text is at the end
of the header. Unmodified. It decodes MW1's JPEG and PNG pictures.


Art and video
-------------
MechWarrior 1 Remake's own pictures and the DropShip launch video were made for
this project with locally run generative models, then chosen and edited by the
author. They contain no art or footage from MechWarrior, MechWarrior 3 or
Pirate's Moon. MW1's text, MechWarrior 3's and Pirate's Moon's 'Mechs, worlds
and sounds are read from the player's own installed games and are not included.
